examples.turkish: Program, ergenlerin özgüvenlerini geliştirmelerine yardımcı olmak için tasarlanmıştır.

examples.english: Adolescents often face many challenges during their growth.
examples.turkish: Ergenler, büyüme döneminde sıklıkla birçok zorlukla karşılaşırlar.

examples.english: The study focused on adolescent behavior in urban areas.
examples.turkish: Çalışma, kentsel alanlardaki ergen davranışlarına odaklandı.

english_meaning: the act of taking up or starting to use something new; also, legally taking another's child

examples.english: The adoption of new technology has transformed the industry.
They celebrated the adoption of their new daughter.
Adoption of healthier habits can improve quality of life.
examples.turkish: Daha sağlıklı alışkanlıkların benimsenmesi yaşam kalitesini artırabilir.

english_meaning: preventing success or development; harmful; unfavorable

examples.english: Adverse weather conditions delayed the flight.
examples.turkish: Olumsuz hava koşulları uçağın kalkışını geciktirdi.

examples.english: The medication had adverse side effects.
They had to cancel the event due to adverse circumstances.
examples.turkish: Olumsuz koşullar nedeniyle etkinliği iptal etmek zorunda kaldılar.

english_meaning: to publicly support or recommend a particular cause or policy; a person who does so

examples.english: She is a well-known advocate for animal rights.
examples.turkish: O, hayvan hakları konusunda tanınmış bir savunucudur.

examples.english: They advocate for better working conditions.
He advocates policies that promote equality.

english_meaning: concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty

examples.english: The room was decorated in an aesthetic style.
examples.turkish: Oda, estetik bir tarzda dekore edilmişti.

examples.english: He has a strong aesthetic sense in art.
examples.turkish: Sanatta güçlü bir estetik anlayışı var.

examples.english: The aesthetic appeal of the design was undeniable.

english_meaning: a gentle feeling of fondness or liking

examples.english: The mother showed great affection for her child.
examples.turkish: Anne, çocuğuna büyük bir şefkat gösterdi.

examples.english: He expressed his affection with a warm smile.
examples.turkish: Sıcacık bir gülümsemeyle sevgisini ifade etti.

examples.english: Affection is often shown through simple gestures.

english_meaning: inexpensive; reasonably priced

examples.english: They found an affordable apartment in the city.
examples.turkish: Şehirde uygun fiyatlı bir daire buldular.

examples.english: The store offers a range of affordable products.
Affordable healthcare is a major concern for many.
examples.turkish: Uygun fiyatlı sağlık hizmeti pek çok kişi için önemli bir konudur.

english_meaning: the consequences or aftereffects of a significant unpleasant event

examples.english: The aftermath of the storm left many homeless.
examples.turkish: Fırtınanın ardından birçok kişi evsiz kaldı.

examples.english: They struggled to recover in the aftermath of the disaster.
The political aftermath of the election was intense.

english_meaning: behaviour that is forceful, hostile, or attacking

examples.english: The coach warned the players against unnecessary aggression.
examples.turkish: Koç, oyuncuları gereksiz saldırganlıktan kaçınmaları konusunda uyardı.

examples.english: His aggression in the debate was off-putting.
Military aggression often leads to serious consequences.
examples.turkish: Askeri saldırganlık genellikle ciddi sonuçlara yol açar.

english_meaning: relating to farming or agriculture

examples.english: They adopted new agricultural methods to improve crop yield.
examples.turkish: Mahsul verimini artırmak için yeni tarımsal yöntemler benimsediler.

examples.english: The country relies heavily on its agricultural sector.
examples.turkish: Ülke, tarımsal sektörüne büyük ölçüde bağlıdır.

examples.english: Agricultural policies are vital for rural development.
examples.turkish: Kırsal kalkınma için tarımsal politikalar hayati öneme sahiptir.

english_meaning: the practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil and the rearing of animals

examples.english: Agriculture is the backbone of many developing countries.
examples.turkish: Tarım, birçok gelişmekte olan ülkenin belkemiğidir.

examples.english: She studied agriculture to improve sustainable farming techniques.
examples.turkish: Sürdürülebilir çiftçilik tekniklerini geliştirmek için tarım eğitimi aldı.

examples.english: Modern agriculture relies on advanced technology.

english_meaning: an assistant to an important person, especially a political leader

examples.english: The president's aide arranged the meeting.
She worked as an aide during the campaign.
examples.turkish: Seçim kampanyası sırasında yardımcı olarak çalıştı.

examples.english: An aide is responsible for managing schedules and communications.
examples.turkish: Bir yardımcı, programları ve iletişimi yönetmekten sorumludur.

english_meaning: a disease of the human immune system caused by the HIV virus

examples.english: AIDS has affected millions of people worldwide.
examples.turkish: AIDS, dünya çapında milyonlarca insanı etkiledi.

examples.english: There are ongoing efforts to find a cure for AIDS.
examples.turkish: AIDS için tedavi bulmaya yönelik çalışmalar sürüyor.

examples.english: Public awareness campaigns about AIDS are essential.
examples.turkish: AIDS hakkında kamu bilinci oluşturma kampanyaları hayati önem taşır.

english_meaning: although; even though

examples.english: The movie was enjoyable, albeit a bit long.
examples.turkish: Film keyifliydi, her ne kadar biraz uzun olsa da.

examples.english: He accepted the job, albeit reluctantly.
examples.turkish: İşi, gönülsüzce de olsa kabul etti.

examples.english: They succeeded, albeit with many challenges.
examples.turkish: Pek çok zorluğa rağmen başarılı oldular.

english_meaning: quick to notice any unusual and potentially dangerous or difficult circumstances; a warning

examples.english: The guard remained alert throughout the night.
She set an alert on her phone for the meeting.
examples.turkish: Telefonuna toplantı için bir uyarı kurdu.

examples.english: The sudden alert caught everyone’s attention.

english_meaning: belonging to a foreign country or nation; a being from another planet

examples.english: The movie featured an alien from another galaxy.
examples.turkish: Film, başka bir galaksiden gelen bir uzaylıyı içeriyordu.

examples.english: He felt like an alien in a strange land.
examples.turkish: Kendini yabancı bir ülkede yabancı gibi hissetti.

examples.english: The novel explores themes of alienation and isolation.
examples.turkish: Roman, yabancılaşma ve yalnızlık temalarını inceliyor.

english_meaning: to place in a line or to adjust in relation to something else

examples.english: Please align the pictures on the wall.
Their goals align perfectly with the company’s mission.
examples.turkish: Hedefleri, şirketin misyonuyla mükemmel uyum sağlıyor.

examples.english: The text was aligned to the left margin.

english_meaning: arrangement in a straight line or in correct relative positions

examples.english: The alignment of the columns was flawless.
Proper alignment is essential for a professional look.
examples.turkish: Profesyonel bir görünüm için doğru hizalama şarttır.

examples.english: They discussed the alignment of their goals for the project.

english_meaning: in the same or a similar way; similar

examples.english: The twins dress alike.
Their opinions are very much alike.
Everything in the room looked alike.

english_meaning: a claim or assertion that someone has done something wrong

examples.english: The allegation of fraud shocked the board.
examples.turkish: Dolandırıcılık iddiası kurulda şok etkisi yarattı.

examples.english: There is no evidence to support the allegation.
He vehemently denied all allegations against him.
examples.turkish: Kendisine yöneltilen tüm suçlamaları şiddetle reddetti.

english_meaning: to claim or assert that someone has done something wrong, typically without proof

examples.english: They allege that the company misused funds.
examples.turkish: Şirketin fonları kötüye kullandığını iddia ediyorlar.

examples.english: He alleges that his rights were violated.
The report alleges corruption at high levels.
examples.turkish: Rapor, üst düzeylerde yolsuzluk iddia ediyor.

english_meaning: used to convey that something is claimed to be the case or have taken place, although there is no proof

examples.english: He allegedly stole a large sum of money.
examples.turkish: Büyük bir para çaldığı iddia ediliyor.

examples.english: The politician was allegedly involved in the scandal.
The document was allegedly signed by the CEO.
examples.turkish: Belgenin CEO tarafından imzalandığı iddia ediliyor.

english_meaning: a union or association formed for mutual benefit, especially between countries or organizations

examples.english: The two countries formed a strategic alliance.
examples.turkish: İki ülke stratejik bir ittifak kurdu.

examples.english: Their alliance strengthened their position in the market.
An alliance was necessary to address the global issue.
examples.turkish: Küresel soruna çözüm bulmak için bir ittifak gerekliydi.

english_meaning: to distribute resources or duties for a specific purpose

examples.english: The manager allocated resources for the new project.
examples.turkish: Yönetici, yeni proje için kaynakları tahsis etti.

examples.english: Funds were allocated to improve the school facilities.
examples.turkish: Okul olanaklarını iyileştirmek için fonlar paylaştırıldı.

examples.english: They allocated a specific budget for marketing.
examples.turkish: Pazarlama için belirli bir bütçe ayırdılar.

english_meaning: the action or process of distributing something

examples.english: The allocation of funds was clearly outlined in the report.
Proper allocation of resources is key to success.
There was an unequal allocation of tasks among the team.
examples.turkish: Takım arasında görevlerin eşit olmayan bir şekilde dağıtıldığı görüldü.

english_meaning: an amount of something, typically money, given regularly or for a specific purpose

examples.english: She receives a weekly allowance from her parents.
They provided an allowance for travel expenses.
examples.turkish: Seyahat masrafları için bir ödenek sağladılar.

examples.english: The company offers a generous allowance for meals.
examples.turkish: Şirket, yemekler için cömert bir ödenek sunuyor.

english_meaning: a person, group, or nation that cooperates with or helps another in a particular activity

examples.english: During the war, the country found a strong ally in its neighbor.
examples.turkish: Savaş sırasında ülke, komşusunda güçlü bir müttefik buldu.

examples.english: They became allies to achieve common goals.
examples.turkish: Ortak hedeflere ulaşmak için müttefik oldular.

examples.english: Her ally supported her during the tough times.

english_meaning: close to or next to something

examples.english: The new building was constructed alongside the river.
examples.turkish: Yeni bina, nehrin yanında inşa edildi.

examples.english: He worked alongside his colleagues on the project.
The park is located alongside the main road.
examples.turkish: Park, ana yolun yanında yer alıyor.

english_meaning: completely; entirely; in total

examples.english: Altogether, the experience was unforgettable.
They spent altogether three hours discussing the issue.
examples.turkish: Konuyu tartışmak için toplamda üç saat harcadılar.

examples.english: Altogether, the performance exceeded expectations.

english_meaning: a lightweight, silvery-white metallic element used in manufacturing

examples.english: Aluminium is commonly used in the production of airplanes.
examples.turkish: Alüminyum, uçak üretiminde yaygın olarak kullanılır.

examples.english: The window frame is made of aluminium for durability.
examples.turkish: Pencere çerçevesi dayanıklılık için alüminyumdan yapılmıştır.

examples.english: They recycled the aluminium cans after the event.
examples.turkish: Etkinlikten sonra alüminyum kutuları geri dönüştürdüler.

english_meaning: engaging in an activity for pleasure rather than for financial benefit; a person who engages in such an activity

examples.english: He is an amateur photographer with a keen eye for detail.
examples.turkish: O, detaylara keskin bir gözle bakan amatör bir fotoğrafçıdır.

examples.english: The amateur band performed at the local festival.
examples.turkish: Amatör grup, yerel festivalde sahne aldı.

examples.english: Although an amateur, her work was impressive.

english_meaning: an official envoy, especially a high-ranking diplomat who represents a state

examples.english: The ambassador hosted a dinner for foreign dignitaries.
examples.turkish: Büyükelçi, yabancı önemli şahsiyetler için bir akşam yemeği düzenledi.

examples.english: She was appointed as the new ambassador to several countries.
examples.turkish: Birkaç ülkeye yeni büyükelçi olarak atandı.

examples.english: The ambassador worked to improve bilateral relations.
examples.turkish: Büyükelçi, ikili ilişkileri geliştirmek için çalıştı.

english_meaning: a vehicle equipped for taking sick or injured people to and from the hospital

examples.english: An ambulance arrived quickly after the accident.
The ambulance sped through the city to reach the hospital.
examples.turkish: Ambulans, hastaneye ulaşmak için şehirden hızla geçti.

examples.english: He waved as the ambulance drove by.

english_meaning: to make minor changes to something, usually to improve it or make it more accurate

examples.english: They decided to amend the contract to reflect the new terms.
examples.turkish: Yeni şartları yansıtmak için sözleşmeyi değiştirmeye karar verdiler.

examples.english: The document was amended to correct several errors.
examples.turkish: Belge, birkaç hatayı düzeltmek için değiştirildi.

examples.english: He suggested amending the rules for better clarity.
examples.turkish: Kuralların daha net olması için değiştirilmesini önerdi.

english_meaning: a change or addition designed to improve a text, piece of legislation, etc.

examples.english: The amendment to the law was passed unanimously.
examples.turkish: Yasa üzerindeki değişiklik oybirliğiyle kabul edildi.

examples.english: They proposed several amendments to improve the draft.
examples.turkish: Taslağı iyileştirmek için birkaç değişiklik önerdiler.

examples.english: The constitution includes an amendment protecting freedom of speech.
examples.turkish: Anayasa, ifade özgürlüğünü koruyan bir değişikliği içerir.

english_meaning: surrounded by; in the middle of

examples.english: The town stood amid lush green hills.
examples.turkish: Kasaba, yemyeşil tepelerin ortasında yer alıyordu.

examples.english: Amid the chaos, she remained calm.
They found shelter amid the heavy rain.

english_meaning: entertaining; funny

examples.english: The comedian told an amusing story.
It was an amusing conversation that brightened the day.
Children found the clown very amusing.

english_meaning: a comparison between two things, typically for the purpose of explanation or clarification

examples.english: She drew an analogy between the human brain and a computer.
examples.turkish: İnsan beyni ile bilgisayar arasında bir benzetme yaptı.

examples.english: The teacher used an analogy to explain the concept.
examples.turkish: Öğretmen, kavramı açıklamak için bir benzetme kullandı.

examples.english: Analogies help in understanding complex ideas.
examples.turkish: Benzetmeler, karmaşık fikirleri anlamaya yardımcı olur.

english_meaning: a person who conducts analysis, especially in the field of business or finance

examples.english: The financial analyst predicted a rise in stock prices.
examples.turkish: Finansal analist, hisse senedi fiyatlarının artacağını öngördü.

examples.english: She works as an analyst at a major investment firm.
examples.turkish: Büyük bir yatırım şirketinde analist olarak çalışıyor.

examples.english: An experienced analyst can interpret market trends effectively.
examples.turkish: Deneyimli bir analist, piyasa trendlerini etkili bir şekilde yorumlayabilir.

english_meaning: a person from whom one is descended; a forebear

examples.english: He traced his ancestors back to Europe.
Ancestors often influence family traditions.
The museum displayed artifacts from ancient ancestors.
examples.turkish: Müze, eski atalardan kalma eserleri sergiledi.

english_meaning: a heavy device attached to a vessel to keep it in place; a central figure or main element

examples.english: The ship dropped its anchor in the harbor.
She served as the anchor of the news program.
examples.turkish: Haber programının sunucusu merkezi bir figür olarak görev yaptı.

examples.english: The discussion was anchored by his insightful comments.

english_meaning: a spiritual being believed to act as an attendant, agent, or messenger of God

examples.english: The painting depicted an angel with outstretched wings.
examples.turkish: Resim, kanatlarını açmış bir meleği tasvir ediyordu.

examples.english: She was described as an angel for her kindness.
In many cultures, angels are seen as protectors.
examples.turkish: Birçok kültürde melekler koruyucu olarak görülür.

english_meaning: the technique of photographing successive drawings to create an illusion of movement

examples.english: The animation in the movie was stunning.
She studied animation to create her own cartoons.
examples.turkish: Kendi çizgi filmlerini yapmak için animasyon eğitimi aldı.

examples.english: Advances in computer animation have revolutionized the film industry.
examples.turkish: Bilgisayar animasyonundaki gelişmeler sinema sektörünü devrim niteliğinde değiştirdi.

english_meaning: once a year; every year

examples.english: The festival is held annually in the summer.
examples.turkish: Festival yaz aylarında yılda bir düzenlenir.

examples.english: They publish an annual report annually.
examples.turkish: Her yıl yıllık bir rapor yayımlıyorlar.

examples.english: Annually, the company reviews its performance.
examples.turkish: Şirket her yıl performansını gözden geçirir.

english_meaning: not identified by name; of unknown name

examples.english: The donation was made by an anonymous benefactor.
examples.turkish: Bağış, isimsiz bir hayırsever tarafından yapıldı.

examples.english: She wrote an anonymous letter to the editor.
Many online comments are posted anonymously.
examples.turkish: Çevrimiçi yorumların çoğu anonim olarak yapılır.

english_meaning: to expect or predict something; to look forward to

examples.english: They anticipate a rise in demand during the holiday season.
I anticipate that the project will be completed on time.
She anticipated his reaction before speaking.

english_meaning: a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome

examples.english: He suffered from severe anxiety before the exam.
Her anxiety was evident in her trembling hands.
Techniques such as meditation can help reduce anxiety.
examples.turkish: Meditasyon gibi teknikler, kaygıyı azaltmaya yardımcı olabilir.

english_meaning: an expression of regret for having done something wrong

examples.english: He offered a sincere apology for his mistake.
examples.turkish: Hatası için samimi bir özür diledi.

examples.english: She sent an apology letter to her friend.
An apology was issued after the incident.

english_meaning: the technical equipment or machinery needed for a particular activity or purpose

examples.english: The laboratory is equipped with modern apparatus.
They assembled the apparatus required for the experiment.
Proper maintenance of the apparatus is essential.

english_meaning: attractive or interesting

examples.english: The design of the website is very appealing.
She found his ideas appealing and innovative.
examples.turkish: Onun fikirlerini çekici ve yenilikçi buldu.

examples.english: The offer was appealing enough to make him reconsider.
examples.turkish: Teklif, onu yeniden düşünmeye sevk edecek kadar cazipti.

english_meaning: a natural desire to satisfy a bodily need, especially for food

examples.english: After the long hike, his appetite increased significantly.
examples.turkish: Uzun yürüyüşün ardından iştahı önemli ölçüde arttı.

examples.english: She lost her appetite after hearing the bad news.
examples.turkish: Kötü haberi duyduktan sonra iştahını kaybetti.

examples.english: A healthy appetite is important for overall well-being.
examples.turkish: Genel sağlık için sağlıklı bir iştah önemlidir.

english_meaning: to show approval or praise by clapping hands

examples.english: The audience began to applaud at the end of the performance.
We applaud her efforts to improve the community.
examples.turkish: Toplumu geliştirmek için gösterdiği çabaları alkışlıyoruz.

examples.english: The coach applauded the team's hard work.

english_meaning: relevant or appropriate to a particular situation

examples.english: The new rules are applicable to all employees.
examples.turkish: Yeni kurallar tüm çalışanlar için geçerlidir.

examples.english: This discount is applicable only during the summer sale.
examples.turkish: Bu indirim sadece yaz indirimlerinde geçerlidir.

examples.english: Make sure the guidelines are applicable to your project.
examples.turkish: Yönergelerin projenize uygulanabilir olduğundan emin olun.

english_meaning: a person who applies for something, such as a job or admission

examples.english: Each applicant must submit a resume and cover letter.
examples.turkish: Her adayın özgeçmiş ve ön yazı sunması gerekir.

examples.english: The university received hundreds of applicants this year.
examples.turkish: Üniversite bu yıl yüzlerce başvuran aldı.

examples.english: The applicant impressed the interview panel.

english_meaning: to assign a job or role to someone

examples.english: The board will appoint a new director next month.
examples.turkish: Yönetim kurulu gelecek ay yeni bir direktör atayacak.

examples.english: She was appointed to lead the project.
They appointed him as the team leader.

english_meaning: recognition and enjoyment of the good qualities of someone or something

examples.english: She expressed her appreciation for the hard work of her colleagues.
examples.turkish: Çalışma arkadaşlarının sıkı çalışmalarını takdir etti.

examples.english: The teacher's appreciation encouraged the students.
A simple thank-you note is a sign of appreciation.
examples.turkish: Basit bir teşekkür notu, takdiri gösterir.

english_meaning: in a manner that is suitable or proper in the circumstances

examples.english: He dressed appropriately for the formal event.
examples.turkish: Resmi etkinlik için uygun şekilde giyindi.

examples.english: The data was analyzed appropriately.
She responded appropriately to the criticism.

english_meaning: based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or system

examples.english: The decision seemed arbitrary and lacked justification.
examples.turkish: Karar keyfi görünüyordu ve gerekçeden yoksundu.

examples.english: Her arbitrary rule changes confused everyone.
examples.turkish: Onun keyfi kural değişiklikleri herkesi şaşırttı.

examples.english: Avoid making arbitrary decisions without proper analysis.
examples.turkish: Uygun analiz yapmadan keyfi kararlar vermekten kaçının.

english_meaning: relating to the art or practice of designing and constructing buildings

examples.english: The museum features stunning architectural designs.
He studied architectural history at the university.
Architectural innovations have transformed modern cities.

english_meaning: a collection of historical documents or records providing information about a place, institution, or group of people

examples.english: The national archive holds documents dating back centuries.
examples.turkish: Ulusal arşiv, yüzyıllar öncesine ait belgeleri saklar.

examples.english: Researchers visited the archive to study ancient manuscripts.
examples.turkish: Araştırmacılar, antik el yazmalarını incelemek için arşivi ziyaret etti.

examples.english: She organized her photos into a digital archive.

english_meaning: a level area surrounded by seats for spectators, in which sports, entertainments, or other public events are held

examples.english: The concert was held in a massive arena.
Fans filled the arena to cheer on their team.
examples.turkish: Taraftarlar, takımlarını alkışlamak için arenayı doldurdu.

examples.english: The arena was designed with excellent acoustics.
examples.turkish: Arena, mükemmel akustiğe sahip olacak şekilde tasarlandı.

english_meaning: used to indicate that a claim or belief is open to debate but is supported by reasonable arguments
turkish_meaning: muhtemelen, tartışmaya açık ama iddia edilebilir şekilde

examples.english: He is arguably the best player on the team.
examples.turkish: Takımın en iyi oyuncusu olduğu söylenebilir.

examples.english: This is arguably one of the most important discoveries of the decade.
examples.turkish: Bu, on yılın en önemli keşiflerinden biri olarak kabul edilebilir.

examples.english: The policy is arguably beneficial for small businesses.
examples.turkish: Politikanın küçük işletmeler için yararlı olduğu iddia edilebilir.

english_meaning: to equip with weapons; also, the upper limb of the human body

examples.english: They decided to arm the soldiers with new technology.
examples.turkish: Askerleri yeni teknolojiyle silahlandırmaya karar verdiler.

examples.english: He broke his arm during the game.
The company was armed with the latest research.

english_meaning: an impressive display or range of a particular type of thing

examples.english: The store offered an array of exotic spices.
An impressive array of talent was on display at the concert.
examples.turkish: Konserde etkileyici bir yetenek çeşitliliği sergilendi.

examples.english: They arranged the data in an easy-to-read array.
examples.turkish: Verileri okunması kolay bir dizi halinde düzenlediler.

english_meaning: a thin, pointed piece of wood with a sharp tip, shot from a bow

examples.english: The archer released the arrow with great precision.
examples.turkish: Okçu, oku büyük bir hassasiyetle fırlattı.

examples.english: The sign had an arrow pointing to the exit.
In the game, the arrow indicates the direction to follow.
examples.turkish: Oyunda, ok takip edilecek yönü gösterir.

english_meaning: to express something clearly in speech or writing

examples.english: She was able to articulate her ideas effectively.
examples.turkish: Fikirlerini etkili bir şekilde dile getirebildi.

examples.english: He struggled to articulate his emotions.
The teacher asked him to articulate his understanding of the topic.
